title: BTC fixed 08:00-16:00 UTC session long/cash timing
thesis: BTC returns may be concentrated during the fixed European and North American overlap-adjacent UTC session strongly enough that holding spot only from 08:00 to 16:00 UTC preserves meaningful upside while reducing exposure and drawdown after daily two-sided fees and adverse slippage.
mechanism: The clock-only policy buys full BTC at every 08:00 UTC H1 open and sells all at the same day's 16:00 UTC H1 open. It uses no price, volume, regime or outcome feature and executes the same schedule on every complete UTC day.
economic_rationale: The mechanism is credible only if a persistent intraday return premium compensates for one round trip per day, produces superior Calmar and materially lower drawdown, survives 07:00-15:00 and 09:00-17:00 rejection-only windows, and is broad across years rather than concentrated in one regime.
